features.survival: Home Instadeath 1P/2P: one life, one-hit death, no energy, no bonus lives or continues; shared co-op timer freezes on pause and ends with the last survivor. Pressure increases every 20 seconds to 16 scheduled enemies with faster spawning and movement.
features.saves: CRC-32 two-slot SRAM records; independent Home options and Arcade DIP banks; regular-score boards per ruleset; separate 1P/2P survival-time boards; auto-commit at options confirmation and completed runs.
features.reset_actions: Home Options has separately confirmed Reset Options and Clear Scores actions; each preserves the other data.

validation_scope: Rules tests drive the real Home menu and use overlapping enemy-body fixtures to verify actual contact death. Timer-ramp checks inject the elapsed-time checkpoint.

Pressure benchmarks inject the maximum pressure and a prolonged invulnerable grace flow; simulation, AI, projectiles, firing, rendering and audio remain active. They are computational stress fixtures, not unassisted survival runs.
Battery-save tests use fresh emulator processes and dedicated on-disk NVRAM; high-score/config fixtures are explicitly injected before normal menu confirmation or game-over finalization.
The previous base-port long-run reports are retained with their original ROM identity under out/before-survival-sram.
Physical console/cart/flashcart persistence and PAL timing are not verified.
